$comment: Shared house rules for this repo. Committed. Per-machine overrides belong in
settings.local.json, which is gitignored. .Rbuildignore keeps the whole .claude/
directory out of the package tarball.
Allow-list only: documentation for the model families Rceattle is checked against
(TMB, WHAM, SAM, SS3, FIMS), R's own docs, and the literature its likelihoods cite.
There is deliberately no deny block -- see CLAUDE.md for the rules that are enforced
by review rather than by permissions.
